as_told.title: Kidnapping attempt at the PSI games

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs seem to show up around him and who now speaks about it in public, tells this on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He says that after giving a talk at a conference, which he names as an event he calls the PSI games, held this year, a frantic woman ran up to him as he walked out the door and tried to kidnap him. He tells it as an example of the strange and sometimes risky attention his story brings him.
